snippet.title: Marvel Tōkon: Fighting Souls - Unbreakable X-Men Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
As a new threat looms over Earth, the X-Men are the first to answer the call to defend our planet!
Meet the Unbreakable X-Men, the first fully revealed team in MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls!
Coming to PS5 and PC on August 6th, 2026!
